annotations.text:
Marks painted under each support icon from the cell rects the capture already has (3 px bar; a ? badge on a cell a hover would settle). Name, verdict and status live in a panel anchored 12 px right of the recruit panel, top-aligned with its first row.
Settled 2026-09-07: the reader grabs the whole monitor, so the strip's window is excluded from capture for the duration of each grab (capture.rs) and stays in the player's own screenshots between grabs.

Same panel in four states: SKIP while reading; WORTH with one guide; WORTH with three guides and a name the OCR mangled; WORTH with a tiered rung. WORTH sits on its own line, the guides as chips on the line below; a rung's tier rides on its chip as a tag whose fill deepens up the ladder (mv · mid · end · gg). Guide pairings in the last panel are sample values.
Mirror: rows in the game's order, cells left-aligned in slot order at a square rhythm. Same window, same width, no engine change. Tradeoff: correspondence is by order, not by screen position.
B — Names. Support NAMES instead of marks. Tradeoff: taller and wraps at 460 px; an unread cell has no name to show. Gem names here are sample values.
C — In place. Marks painted under each icon; verdict and status as small tags on the two empty rows. Superseded by the Proposal page.
